questRecommendationLogic.description: For each user, fetch their TopicPerformance array. Sort topics by confidenceScore ASC to find weak topics. Apply weakTopicBoost to questions in those topics. Filter by userLevel and preferredDifficulty. Apply company boost if targetCompany set. Sort by (boost * isStriver + isBlind75 + isNeetCode150) DESC. Return top N unsolved questions.

dailyQuestFormula.BEGINNER: 2 EASY from weakest topic + 1 EASY from random topic
dailyQuestFormula.INTERMEDIATE: 1 MEDIUM from weakest topic + 1 MEDIUM from target topic + 1 EASY revision
dailyQuestFormula.ADVANCED: 2 MEDIUM from weak topics + 1 HARD if streakDays > 7
